title: eludite.nuget.update input
description: Update packages (Updates' Update, with Select All: `all`). The project files (or Directory.Packages.props under Central Package Management) are edited with their formatting kept, then restored unless the setting nuget.restoreOnChange is off; a failed restore leaves the edit, with its errors in the answer and the Error List. Class execute under the solution policy's `nuget.change` (agents are asked by default). Every change is audited with the project, the package and the version.

project.description: A project of the open solution: its name (`App`) or the absolute path of its project file.

all.description: Every package eludite.nuget.updates lists (for `project`, or the solution).
